value.rationale: A new adaptive constrained bundle method relies on transferring W-certificates when increasing a penalty. Establishing that its coefficient \(2r-1\) is minimax necessary, not a loose analysis artifact, delineates a concrete limit to certificate recycling. The lower-bound example obeys strict Slater feasibility, global QG, a unique solution and even survives arbitrary cuts at the fixed candidate, so none of those standard regularity or bundle refinements improves the universal constant; better transfer demands more information or a different candidate.
